title: Insuring Several Condominium Units Under CondoGuard
content:
**Guideline.** A customer may insure several condominium units under the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, one CondoGuard policy per unit, up to 3 live policies counted across the customer's profile. A live policy is one that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal.

**Same-unit check.** A CondoGuard policy is bound on a unit only when no other condominium policy that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal covers the same unit address. The check is made on the company's policy records before the policy is bound, and it matches on the unit address of the policy being bound.

| Status of an existing condominium policy on the same unit address | Counts as live | Blocks a new policy on that address |
|---|---|---|
| bound | yes | yes |
| in force | yes | yes |
| pending cancellation | yes | yes |
| pending nonrenewal | yes | yes |
| cancelled | no | no |
| expired | no | no |

## Cases (hypothetical profiles)

- A customer holds two in-force CondoGuard policies on two different units and one expired CondoGuard policy on a third. The live count is 2, so a policy on a fourth unit brings the count to 3, which is within the limit of 3.
- A customer holds three live CondoGuard policies, one of them pending nonrenewal. The count is already 3, the most the profile may carry.
- A condominium policy on the same unit address that was cancelled does not block a new CondoGuard policy on that address; one that is pending cancellation does.
